scripts.text: Okay, that's enough. It will open a passage to the place where the unholy energy is on the time seal seen there.
scripts.translation: 好了，這樣就夠了。它會開啟一條通道，通往那裡時間封印上帶有不潔能量的地方。

scripts.text: Are you ready? Then extend your hand forward and keep your eyes on the seal as if you are focusing the power I'm giving you onto the seal.
scripts.translation: 準備好了嗎？那就向前伸出手，注視封印，彷彿要把我賦予你的力量集中到封印上。

scripts.text: Reach out hand and watch the seal
Now then, let's open the other one as well. Move to the site opposite this gate.
scripts.translation: 那麼，我們也開啟另一處吧。去這道門對面的地點。

scripts.text: It's simpler than you think, isn't it?. With this, we'll be able to stop strange guys from flooding the garden until Oscar completes the mansion, so it's a relief.
scripts.translation: 沒你想的那麼複雜，對吧？這樣一來，在奧斯卡完成宅邸之前，奇怪的傢伙就無法湧進花園了，真讓人安心。

scripts.text: And since you've already helped me, from now on you'll have to work with me every day. It's no big deal. Reduce the number of unholy things in the dungeon under the passage created here.
scripts.translation: 既然你已經幫過我，從現在起每天都得和我一起工作。沒什麼大不了的，把這條通道下方地牢裡的不潔之物減少一些就行。

scripts.text: I think I've heard this before
Why are you muttering? Do you have any complaints?
scripts.translation: 你在嘀咕什麼？有什麼不滿嗎？

scripts.text: I think it's finished. Let's come to the central square for a moment and talk about the next thing.
scripts.translation: 我想事情已經辦妥了。我們先去中央廣場，談談接下來的事。

scripts.text: Would you like to go back to the Garden of Time?
Would you like to go back to the Garden of Time?
^777700Oh, the adventurer Leticia sent has finally arrived.
scripts.translation: ^777700哦，萊蒂西亞派來的冒險者終於到了。

scripts.text: ^aa0000Adventurer! Are you willing to fight? We don't need a weakling!
scripts.translation: ^aa0000冒險者！你願意戰鬥嗎？我們不需要弱者！

scripts.text: ^0000ffArdor! Have you forgotten what Leticia told you to be at least polite?
scripts.translation: ^0000ff阿爾多！你忘了萊蒂西亞叫你至少要有禮貌嗎？

scripts.text: ^00cc00Diluvio is right. It would be good to show some courtesy to the humans who come to help us.
scripts.translation: ^00cc00迪盧維奧說得對。應該對前來幫助我們的人類表示禮貌。

scripts.text: I'm fine, please tell me what to do
scripts.translation: 我沒關係，請告訴我要做什麼

scripts.text: ^aa00aaWe are ancient spirits from a world connected to this garden. It is an instinct engraved in our spirit bodies to help each natural element remain harmonious.
scripts.translation: ^aa00aa我們是來自與這座花園相連世界的古老精靈。幫助各種自然元素保持和諧，是刻在我們靈體本能中的使命。

scripts.text: ^aa00aaHowever, after being swept away by a strange dimensional storm, the elements of the world connected to this garden began to run wild, and eventually began to turn into spirits.
scripts.translation: ^aa00aa然而，一場奇怪的次元風暴席捲了那個世界後，與花園相連世界的元素開始失控，最終逐漸化為精靈。

scripts.text: ^777700If the elements continue to become elementals, eventually the material world that makes up this world will collapse. That must be prevented.
scripts.translation: ^777700如果元素繼續化為精靈，構成這個世界的物質界最終就會崩塌。我們必須阻止這種事發生。

scripts.text: ^0000ffAdventurer, you must no longer allow the elements to turn into spirits. Use your power to send them back to nature.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff冒險者，你不能再讓元素化為精靈了。用你的力量讓它們迴歸自然吧。

scripts.text: ^777700This is not an act of destroying nature. It is a matter of returning the disappearing elements that have been transformed into spirits back to their original positions. Will you listen to our request?
scripts.translation: ^777700這並非破壞自然，而是讓那些消失、並轉化為精靈的元素回到原本的位置。你願意聽從我們的請求嗎？

scripts.text: ^aa0000You're a good communicator! Okay then, I'll tell you what to do every day!^000000
scripts.translation: ^aa0000你真會說話！好吧，那我每天告訴你該做什麼！^000000

scripts.text: ^aa0000Let's place the sacred items prepared by the constellations across from us. In human language, it's called a vending machine.^000000
scripts.translation: ^aa0000把對面的星座準備的聖物放好吧。用人類的話來說，那叫自動販賣機。^000000

scripts.text: ^aa0000The reward for helping us and the constellations' work here will be received through that sacred item.^000000
scripts.translation: ^aa0000幫助我們和星座在這裡工作的獎勵，可以通過那件聖物領取。^000000
